{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Fix revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Now check if any revenue values are suspicious (e.g., 999999.99)
print("Unique revenue values:", df['revenue'].unique())

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum()
print("Number of refunded orders:", refunded_count)

# Confirm the QA orders are gone
qa_orders = df[df['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print("Remaining QA orders (revenue = 999999.99):", len(qa_orders))"}
